Wacker Drive, Suite 3575, Chicago, Illinois 60606 (hereinafter referred to as "Purchaser"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Declarantisthefeeownerofacertainparceloflandlocatedinthe City of New York, County of Kings and State of New York, known as the street address 486-496     s     n    hereto, and also formerly known as Block 159, Tax Lot 1 on the Tax Map of the County of Kings, State of New York; and WHEREAS, the land described in Exhibit A is improved with a five-story building, which land and building have been submitted by Declarant to the provisions of Article 9-B of the New York Real Property Law, sometimes referred to as the Condominium Act of the State of New York; said building and related improvements, together.with ·any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the“Condominium Building”, and said land and building and improvements being hereinafter referred to as the“Condominium Property." The Declaration of Condominium (the “Declaration") establishing The 486-496 Fulton Street Condominium (the “Condominium") was recorded in the office of the Kings County Register (the “Register") on 12/14/2012 as CRFN 2012000491699,which divided Tax Lot 1 into two units of the Condominium: Tax Lot 1001 (the “Lower Unit") and Tax Lot 1002 (the “Upper Unit"). The owners of units in the Condominium are hereinafter referred to as “Unit Owners". The floor plans of the Condominium were recorded in the Office of the City Register, Kings County on 12/14/2012aSCRFN2012000491700; WHEREAS, Purchaser is, on this date, purchasing the Upper Unit, Tax Lot 1002 from Declarant; WHEREAS, the Condominium Building contains less “floor area” as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York as amended from time to time (the “Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the floor area ratio limitation contained in the Zoning Resolution related to the Land as an independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, under Article 18 of the Declaration, Declarant has retained the ownershipoftheExcessFloorAreaDevelopmentRights(asdefinedintheDeclaration)asthe owner of the Lower Unit, in order that they may be transferable by Declarant or any subsequent owner thereof; and WHEREAS, Declarant desires that its ownership and right to transfer the Excess Floor Area Development Rights shall continue, notwithstanding the closing of the sale of the HF 8055093v.1 #14881/0001

Lower Unit, and the parties hereto desire to further modify their respective rights and obligations in respect of the Excess Floor Area Development Rights. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the sum of Ten Dollars and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree and do herewith declare,as covenants running with the land under the CondominiumBuilding,with intent to bind all persons and entities having or seeking to acquire anyinterestofanynaturewhatsoeverintheCondominiumPropertyoreithertheLowerUnitor theUpper Unit, as follows: 1. The parties hereto agree that from and after the closing of the sale of the Lower Unit, whether to Purchaser or to any other party, Declarant shall continue to be the beneficial owner of the Excess Floor Area Development Rights and all proceeds thereof shall inure to the benefit of and be paid over to Declarant upon receipt. 2. Purchaser agrees to be bound by all of the provisions of Article 18 of the Declaration; however, it shall take all steps reasonably requested by Declarant, and execute all documents set forth in Article 18 of the Declaration or otherwise, to insure that Declarant shall continue to have all the rights of Declarant set forth therein, and to cooperate with Declarant in connectionwiththesaleand/or transfer of theExcess Floor AreaDevelopmentRights, notwithstanding the conveyance of the Lower Unit. If and to the extent that Purchaser incurs any actual and reasonable out-of-pocket expense as a result of any such request by Declarant, Declarant shall reimburse Purchaser for same within ten (1o) days after demand therefor. 3.Purchaser shall cooperate with Declarant as may be reasonably requested by Declarant in order to permit any party named by Declarant to fully utilize Excess Floor Area Development Rights held by Declarant, including, without limitation, the obtaining of all applications for building permits, temporary and permanent certificates of occupancy and other governmental approvals for any property which Declarant permits the use of Excess Floor Area Development Rights. Such cooperation shall include at no additional expense to Purchaser (and to the extent Purchaser incurs any reasonable expense, Declarant shall reimburse Purchaser for same within ten (10) days after demand therefor), without limitation, the furnishing of whatever additional documents may be required of Purchaser or anyone claiming under Purchaser in order to create the combined zoning lot as contemplated under this Agreement, the filing of any work with therequirements of the City of NewYork. 4. In the event of a breach by either party of its obligations hereunder, the other party shall have such rights and remedies as are available at law or in equity, including without limitation an action for damages against the other party or injunctive relief, provided that neither party shall have the right to take any action to terminate this Agreement or the Declaration without the written consent of the other party.In determining Declarant's damages in the event Purchaser breaches its obligations hereunder, all then-relevant factors may be considered,includingwithoutlimitationthevalueoftheExcessFloorAreaDevelopmentRights as may be evidenced by any agreement for the sale or transfer of same to which Declarant may then be a party, or to which Declarant was a party but for such breach of the Purchaser, and the failure of the closing under such agreement.If any party incurs any legal fees or expenses HF8055093v.1#14881/0001
